accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: All key buttons, inputs, section cards, dial nodes, and navigation links MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Ensure dark brown text (#2D1810) on ivory background (#FAF7F2) achieves minimum 7.5:1 APCA contrast for body text and headers.
accessibility_and_testing.motion_policy: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by falling back from 3D scroll physics to smooth static views.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow the warm off-white canvas theme strictly. Never apply black or dark gray backgrounds.
Do NOT place any Om symbol or mantra text in the center of the bead selector circular dial.
Ensure all 16 beads (1-14 Mukhi, Gaurishankar, Ganesh) are correctly rendered in the circular selector.
Use real image URLs provided in image_urls list for experts, celebrities, and mala assets.
Ensure all interactive components maintain data-testid attributes for automated testing.
